note: Drafted, not run. No with-skill or baseline run exists for these tasks. [script] assertions use scripts/adr_scan.py or a plain string check on the output files; [judge] assertions need a blind grader. The scan is the skill's own tool, so each task has at least one judge assertion about something it does not control.

evals.prompt: Record this in the adr folder, following our existing records. Request text is in evals/files/t1-supersede/request.md and the folder is evals/files/t1-supersede/adr.
assertions: [script] adr_scan.py scan adr prints ok true with zero errors
[script] a new file adr/0003-*.md exists, and no existing number is reused
[script] 0001 now has Status: superseded and 'Superseded by: 0003'; 0003 has 'Supersedes: 0001'
[script] 0003 contains '2 engineer days' or 'two engineer days' and 'six weeks'
[judge] 0003 Context states what changed since 0001 (four consumers, two needing history) and the Decision sentence names Kafka with a reason from that context
[judge] Consequences lists at least one negative (migration cost or per-partition ordering) and a follow-up; no benefit or number appears that the request did not give
[judge] The reasoning text of 0001 (Context, Options, Decision, Consequences) is unchanged apart from status and link lines

evals.prompt: Our adr folder (evals/files/t2-repair/adr) has grown messy. Check it, fix what is mechanical, and list what needs a human decision. Do not invent decisions or consequences we never discussed. Request in evals/files/t2-repair/request.md.
assertions: [script] 0007 and 0001 now mirror each other, or the 0007 Supersedes line is removed: scan shows no missing-backlink
[script] 0010 either has a Superseded by link to an existing ADR or a status other than superseded: scan shows no superseded-without-successor
[script] 0005 no longer links to a missing ADR 0009 with status superseded: scan shows no broken-link
[script] 0003 Consequences does not contain TBD
[judge] The report lists, as needing a human, 0003 (consequences never discussed) and 0007 (only one option) instead of inventing text for them
[judge] No new options, costs or consequences were fabricated; any changed Consequences text is limited to what the original files already imply
[judge] The final report states the remaining scan findings by rule and what was not checked

evals.prompt: Write the ADR for the decision described in evals/files/t3-retro/notes.md, saved in evals/files/t3-retro/adr. Request is in the notes file.
assertions: [script] a new file adr/0003-*.md exists
[script] the file contains '1,100' and '9,000' and '50,000'
[script] the file contains the words 'retroactively'
[script] scan of the folder reports the new file as either clean or with only a few-options finding (no invented second option is needed to pass)
